name: Parry–Romberg syndrome
general: Progressive hemifacial atrophy; check eye and brain (MRI, seizures). Treat while active; reconstruct once stable 1–2 years.

rx.instr: With oral or pulse steroid initially (as for linear morphea)

rx.drug: Autologous fat grafting / dermal fillers (hyaluronic acid) / flaps
